claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the readable model as Canon EOS 700D (photo 2). No evidence provided for 'UK used' or 'very neat and sharp' beyond general appearance.
Witness photos show Canon branding and 'EOS 700D' readable on the camera body (photo 2).

risks.risk: Model mismatch / wrong listing (EOS 600D claimed vs EOS 700D shown). This affects compatibility and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model nameplate/menu showing the exact model (e.g., 'EOS 700D') and the serial number label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as not matching the claimed model and value it at the lower end for the shown model set.

risks.risk: Functional condition unknown (shutter, autofocus, buttons/ports, sensor health).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, live view autofocus on a moving subject, taking a photo, and reviewing image sharpness; plus a quick check of ports (USB/HDMI) and buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/possibly faulty' until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Battery/charger and power accessories may be missing or weak.
risks.proof: Photo of included battery(s) and charger, and a clip showing the camera powering on and charging/holding power.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming batteries/charger are not included or may be weak (worst case).

risks.risk: Memory card not included; affects immediate usability.
risks.proof: Photo showing whether a memory card is included (and its capacity/brand if visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming no memory card is included.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (scratches, fungus, haze, aperture issues), especially for the second lens.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses: front and rear elements at an angle for haze/fungus, and a shot of the aperture blades; plus a test photo at wide and tele/zoom end (for the other lens).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the second lens may have optical issues and discount accordingly.

risks.risk: Accessories/caps/hood/cables/box may be missing, reducing value.
risks.proof: A full accessories spread photo showing caps, lens hood, cables, manuals, and any box/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'minimal accessories only' until confirmed.

risks.risk: Potential scam/incorrect description (Sony claim vs Canon photos; model claim mismatch).
risks.proof: Ask for a current-day photo of the exact item with a handwritten note (buyer name/date) and the camera screen showing the model.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case risk level due to inconsistent claims.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model and serial number label (confirm EOS 700D vs any other model).
Video test: power on, autofocus in live view, take a photo, and show the result on the screen.
Photos of included battery(s) and charger (and a clip showing charging/power-on).
Photo showing whether a memory card is included.
Close-up photos of both lenses’ front and rear elements (check for fungus/haze/scratches) and aperture/blade condition.
Photo of all included accessories (caps, hood, cables, manuals/box if any).
Current-day proof photo with a handwritten note plus the camera screen showing the model.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as Canon DSLR bodies with an EFS 18-55mm lens and a second Canon EOS 700D unit shown; however, functional and accessory details are missing. A worst-case price is still possible based on the shown hardware, while the inconsistent seller claims increase risk but do not prevent pricing.
